name: DOB consistency
message_template: Date of birth differs across documents: {values}.

name: dl equals subject
message_template: Driver's license address equals the subject property ({address}) — occupancy/identity red flag.

name: employer equals subject
message_template: Employer address ({source}) equals the subject property ({address}) — employment red flag.

name: Stated vs documented income variance
message_template: Stated income ({stated}) differs from documented income ({documented}) by {variance}% (> {threshold}%).

name: Employer name consistency (LP-115)
message_template: Documented employer not among the stated employers: {employer}.

name: employer count matches items
message_template: Stated employer count ({employers}) does not match the income-item count ({items}).

name: Undisclosed liability (MISMO vs app)
message_template: Liability on the credit report not disclosed on the application: {holder} ({amount}).

name: stated not on report
message_template: Stated liability not found on the credit report: {holder}.

name: stated missing document
message_template: Stated asset lacks a supporting document: {asset}.

name: Gift-fund documentation chain
message_template: A gift of {amount} is stated but no gift letter / transfer documentation is present.

name: Purchase price matches loan terms
message_template: Stated purchase price ({stated}) differs from the contract price ({documented}).

name: loan vs documented
message_template: Stated loan amount ({stated}) differs from the documented loan terms ({documented}).

name: Occupancy consistency
message_template: Stated occupancy ({stated}) conflicts with the evidence ({evidence}).

name: Statement chaining (continuity)
message_template: Bank-statement continuity is broken or unverified for one or more accounts.
